transport.client_policy: Exact standard HTTPX Client; only default Accept/Accept-Encoding/Connection/User-Agent headers, no subclass send/stream overrides or foreign credential/framing headers.
transport.local_content_encoding: Request identity; refuse compressed success bodies before decoder expansion.
transport.deadline_note: The webhook deadline is distinct from local HTTP client timeout policy.
transport.http_429: Documented rate-limit status. Retryability is local policy, not a vendor atomic nonacceptance or native idempotency guarantee.
transport.retry_after: No MAX header guarantee found. If present, parse standard integer seconds or HTTP-date as a bounded wait hint; fallback 1 second.

messages.local_rendering: Plain text, no markdown/html mode; link preview disabled. Sensitive credentials suppress push notifications.
messages.success_evidence: HTTP200 JSON; matching exact recipient, literal text and optional sender; valid timestamp and nonblank message.body.mid.
messages.sent_semantics: Accepted by API, not delivered or read by a person.

open_app.payload: optional nullable string <=512; local ASCII A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -
open_app.prerequisite: Owner binds HTTPS app URL to moderated bot and supplies its public name.
open_app.sdk_discrepancy: Pinned TS SDK permits absent/null web_app; pinned official OpenAPI requires it. Local contract follows OpenAPI.

subscriptions.local_public_read: Only sanitized URL without query/fragment, time, update_types; discard provider extras.
subscriptions.verification: Read existing, POST desired URL/types/secret once, fresh GET matching own URL/types and preserve known foreign subscriptions; never DELETE foreign URLs.
subscriptions.verified_limit: URL/types readback plus accepted POST secret provenance; real authenticated webhook/secret roundtrip remains unqualified.
subscriptions.webhook_url: Public HTTPS endpoint, implicit443; no explicit port in provider URL.
